seeds.name: Civic Hinge Linear Chain
seeds.concept: A linear chain of three masses: a learning bar at one end, a community commons at the other, and a civic hinge between them. The hinge gathers the school's public face (arrival, the office, the arts and the library) and acts as front door and crossroads, so every passage between learning and commons crosses it.
seeds.intent: Aims to give the school one legible front where visitors, families and daily student movement meet, while keeping classrooms quiet at the far end of the chain and the commons reachable for community use.

moves.serves: Makes the middle mass the public face that holds arrival, the office, care and the library.
Ensures every passage between learning and commons crosses the hinge.
Puts the arts in the public face of the school, starting at ground level.

moves.move: Single learning bar at the end
moves.serves: Keeps all classroom departments together at the quiet end of the chain.

seeds.name: Arts Loft Over the Commons
seeds.concept: A compact closed cluster in which the shared realm is layered vertically: the commons volume forms the base and an arts loft rides on its roof, making one cultural block for gathering, performance and making. A civic block crowned by the library and a plain academic bar complete a triangle, each mass joined to both others.
seeds.intent: Seeks to make arts and performance a visible community destination stacked with the commons, and to give every mass a direct indoor link so daily movement stays short and sheltered.

moves.move: Arts loft on the commons roof
moves.serves: Forms the single cultural block by stacking the arts over the commons volume.
Crowns the civic block with the library over the office and keeps specialized learning beside care and leadership.
Joins each mass to both others so the cluster works as one indoor building.
Completes the triangle with a dedicated three-floor classroom bar.

seeds.name: Detached Campus Pavilions
seeds.concept: Three free-standing pavilions on shared grounds with no built connections, read as a small campus. A self-sufficient learning pavilion also holds daily care. A community pavilion for athletics and dining can open on its own. A low civic-arts pavilion sits at arrival with the library above the office. Movement between the pavilions is outdoors.
seeds.intent: Aims to let the community pavilion operate after hours without opening the rest of the school, and to keep students' daily needs, including the nurse, inside the learning pavilion.

moves.serves: Keeps the three pavilions free-standing on shared grounds.
Keeps classrooms, the nurse and building service together so students rarely need to leave.
Isolates athletics and dining so they can open on their own.
Forms the arrival pavilion with the library directly above the office.

seeds.name: Commons Heart Between Front and Learning
seeds.concept: The commons is the central heart, with a civic front on one side and a learning wing on the other, each joined only through the heart. Arrival leads into the shared volume, and the learning wing lies beyond it, buffered from public entry. The arts move into the learning wing as part of daily teaching.
seeds.intent: Seeks to make the commons the school's social centre and community entry point, while keeping the learning wing and its arts studios away from visitor traffic.

moves.serves: Makes the commons the only connection between the civic front and the learning wing.
Folds the arts into daily teaching beyond the heart, at ground level.
Gives arrival a compact front with the library over the office.
Places the shared volume at the centre of the three-part sequence.

seeds.name: Academy Tower With Care House
seeds.concept: A tall academy holds classrooms over the front office with the library at its crown. Beside it, a care-and-making house pairs specialized learning with the nurse and the arts. Together with the commons, the three masses close a loop around a shared court, each joined directly to the other two.
seeds.intent: Aims to put leadership and the library inside the main learning building, and to give students with special needs a dedicated house with nearby medical care and hands-on arts rooms.

moves.move: Office and library in the academy
moves.serves: Stacks classrooms over the office in the academy, with the library at its crown.
Pairs specialized learning with the nurse and arts in their own house.
Joins each mass to the other two so the loop around the court is continuous.
